name: seal-stamp-confirmation
intent: Stamp descends with angle overshoot, settles to 0°, then a single confirmation ring pulses on a wax-lacquer mark.

copy.hintIdle: Press Run to strike the seal stamp.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Mark appears settled at 0° with ring complete; no descent

Wax mark blooms via scale (not opacity fade); confirmation ring pulses exactly once for pulseMs 280
